question: Identify the synonym of 'Plausible':
solution:
The correct answer is: **3) Believable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Plausible"** means something that seems reasonable or probable; it is believable or likely to be true. (विश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example:** Her explanation for being late was plausible and convinced everyone at the meeting.
 
 
• The correct synonym of "Plausible" is **"Believable"**, which means capable of being believed or accepted as true. (विश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example:** The witness's testimony was believable and helped the jury make their decision.
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Believable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unlikely** (असंभव): Something that is not expected to happen or is improbable.
 
 
• **Example:** It is unlikely that it will snow in the desert.
 
 
 
• **Unbelievable** (अविश्वसनीय): Something that is difficult or impossible to believe.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician's trick was so unbelievable that everyone was left speechless.
 
 
 
• **Incredible** (अद्भुत): Something so extraordinary or amazing that it is hard to believe.
 
 
• **Example:** The view from the mountain was incredible and took my breath away.
